[[File:DecipherCon 2002 Jedi Knights Beal and Kahan 2.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At the [[2002 World Championship]].]]
'''Jeff Kahan''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 4th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Gauntlet]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw30_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: The Gauntlet Dual Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602202806/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>. Kahan won the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] World Championship that the [[Players Committee]] held at [[DecipherCon 2002]], taking $500 and a trophy; [[Justin Beal]] was second.<ref name="pc-nov02">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/november02archives.htm November Updates], swccgpc.com (3 November 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221953/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/november02archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref> The Committee published his Dark Side and Light Side decklists on 12 January 2003.<ref name="pc-jan03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/january03archives.htm January Updates], swccgpc.com (12 January 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030612020737/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/january03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
